The second choose option targets the wrong side; 'Deal 2 damage to each enemy leader' should damage only enemy leaders, not all enemies.

Add implemented support for play-time optional costs that select and engage matching allied followers, then apply cost reduction before resolution.

Add a target selector/effect pattern that can choose either enemy leader or enemy follower, then deal 1 damage to that chosen target before drawing.

The activation condition is encoded incorrectly; 'Activate only if there are at least 3 amulets in your cemetery' should count amulets specifically, not all cards in your cemetery. Add a cemetery condition/filter for cardType amulet count, then gate the activated ability with that condition.
